items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: There was Eddie Richardson was on trumpet and he sang a few songs.

ctx.x: Before we interrupted, we were talking about Emil Barnes and the recording session. And you said it may have been recorded by Barry Martin before another time. What band was it? Who was that?

There was Eddie Richardson was on trumpet and he sang a few songs. Emil Barnes, Clarenheten, No Trombone Play, Femme Bourgeois, Banyol, Sylvester Henry Bass, Henry Revelle, and the piano player came in later on. His name is Sammy Hopkins.
I see. Well, how did the music go? Pretty well, huh? Oh, pretty bad.
